title: Optimistic Boat Charters
specs: Observe sea and shore birds in their natural habitat
Watch for dolphin feeding and playing
See Atlantic City, Absecon Island and Brigantine from the ocean view
Up to 4 guests per 1/2 day sail trip
includes: Modern electronic navigation and safety devices including VHF radios, GPS chart plotter, auto pilot, AIS, and radar
Dodger and bimini top for spray protection and shade
blurb: Guests sail on the 30 foot sloop S/V Optimistic for sightseeing, dolphin watching, and enjoying the sea air. The boat is equipped with modern navigation and safety devices and offers a comfortable experience with a galley, marine toilet, dodger, and bimini top. The environment is smoke-free and drug-free for safety and comfort.
extraNote: S/V Optimistic is a smoke-free and drug-free environment · S/V Optimistic is located in Snug Harbor, off the Absecon Inlet, Atlantic City, NJ.
